Hi Sanjay / Olivia —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Short recap and a couple of concrete next steps so we can lock in the technical deep dive/demo: 

Recap (very quick)
- Primary goals: validate inference latency at scale, discuss data residency options, and quantify unit cost for expected throughput (30–50 rps).
- Key stakeholders: Sanjay (platform), Olivia (integration lead).

Proposed next step: 90-minute technical deep dive/demo with infra/architecture folks. Because we need to include US, EU and APAC stakeholders, I suggested a rotating weekly slot so each region gets a fair time window for live attendance and Q&A. Draft rotation windows below — these are targeted blocks where we can preserve low-latency demos and include our GPU engineers: 

- US window (suitable for US-based teams): 10:00–12:00 PT (US morning)
- EU window (suitable for EU teams): 14:00–16:00 CET (EU afternoon)
- APAC window (suitable for APAC): 18:00–20:00 SGT / HKT (APAC evening)

Suggested cadence: rotate the weekly session among the three windows (week 1: US, week 2: EU, week 3: APAC) — that gives each region one live session every three weeks while keeping a predictable rhythm. For deep technical topics we can optionally extend cadence to biweekly or add an on-demand recorded follow-up.

Can you confirm:
1) Which recurring day(s) of week work best on your side (Tues/Thurs are easiest for our team)?
2) Any blackout dates for Dec/Jan?
3) Who should be the meeting owner on your side (to own calendar invites and attendee list)?

I attached a one-page proposal that shows the rotation matrix and a draft mutual action plan. If that looks good I’ll send a Doodle poll for the first three sessions and lock calendar invites.

Thanks — I’ll pause scheduling until I hear your preferred days.

Best,
Michael Grant
